missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Папа' is grammatically masculine despite the -а ending and stays nominative as the subject. 'Мой' is the masculine modifier, and 'врачом' is the instrumental of profession.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Папу' is the accusative direct object of 'люблю', taking the -у ending of first-declension nouns. 'Своего' shows the masculine animate accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Папы' is genitive after 'у' in the possession frame. The phrase names whose birthday it is, a very common everyday context.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Папе' is in the dative case as the recipient of the gift in 'подарил'. 'Новые часы' is the accusative thing given.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Папой' is the instrumental form required by 'горжусь'. 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental, expressing pride in one's father.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Папе' takes the prepositional form after 'о' to mean talking about dad. A simple, reusable pattern for discussing family.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative. 'Папа' is nominative as the doer of 'купил'. 'Мне' is the dative beneficiary, and 'велосипед' is the accusative object bought.

missions.phrase: Я иду в кино с папой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Папой' is instrumental after 'с', meaning going somewhere together with dad. 'В кино' shows the destination.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Папы' is genitive showing whose car it is. 'Моего' agrees in the masculine genitive, even though 'папа' looks feminine in form.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Папу' is the accusative direct object of 'жду'. 'У школы' uses the genitive to mark the place of waiting.
